Change c0500. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): No; I am not so selfish.

1818 text: Yet, when I am dead, if he should appear; if the ministers of vengeance should conduct him to you, swear that he shall not live—swear that he shall not triumph over my accumulated woes, and live to make another such a wretch as I am.

1831 text: Yet, when I am dead, if he should appear; if the ministers of vengeance should conduct him to you, swear that he shall not live—swear that he shall not triumph over my accumulated woes, and survive to add to the list of his dark crimes.

Diff: Yet, when I am dead, if he should appear; if the ministers of vengeance should conduct him to you, swear that he shall not live—swear that he shall not triumph over my accumulated woes, and [-live-] {+survive+} to [-make another such a wretch as I am-] {+add to the list of his dark crimes+} .

Context after (unchanged): He is eloquent and persuasive; and once his words had even power over my heart: but trust him not.

result.rationale: Replaces 'live to make another such a wretch as I am' (Victor's self-pity, his fate as creator of misery) with 'survive to add to the list of his dark crimes', recasting the creature as a criminal rather than a fellow wretch; the sympathetic parallel is removed.
